name: Saree & Kurta
tagline: Graceful South Asian traditional wear in heritage settings.
description: Celebrate South Asian heritage dress: Banarasi and Kanjeevaram silk sarees, lehengas and anarkalis, kurtas, sherwanis and bandhgalas, photographed in palace courtyards, the pink city, lake terraces, river ghats, haveli doorways, Mughal gardens and temple steps. Draping and details styled with care.
